Professor '''Nils Gunnar Hansson von Heijne''' (born 10 June 1951 in [[Gothenburg]]) is a Swedish scientist<ref>https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=saY_ivoAAAAJ Gunnar von Heijne publications in [[Google Scholar]]</ref> working on [[signal peptide]]s, [[membrane proteins]]<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Emanuelsson | first1 = O. | last2 = Nielsen | first2 = H. | last3 = Brunak | first3 = S. R. | author-link3 = Søren Brunak| last4 = Von Heijne | first4 = G. | author-link4 = Gunnar von Heijne| title = Predicting Subcellular Localization of Proteins Based on their N-terminal Amino Acid Sequence | doi = 10.1006/jmbi.2000.3903 | journal = Journal of Molecular Biology | volume = 300 | issue = 4 | pages = 1005–1016 | year = 2000 | pmid =  10891285| s2cid = 30441491 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Nielsen | first1 = H. | last2 = Engelbrecht | first2 = J. | last3 = Brunak | first3 = S. | last4 = Von Heijne | first4 = G. | title = Identification of prokaryotic and eukaryotic signal peptides and prediction of their cleavage sites | doi = 10.1093/protein/10.1.1 | journal = Protein Engineering Design and Selection | volume = 10 | issue = 1 | pages = 1–6 | year = 1997 | pmid =  9051728| doi-access = free }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Krogh | first1 = A. | author-link1 = Anders Krogh| last2 = Larsson | first2 = B. R. | last3 = Von Heijne | first3 = G. | author-link3 = Gunnar von Heijne| last4 = Sonnhammer | first4 = E. L. L. | title = Predicting transmembrane protein topology with a hidden markov model: Application to complete genomes | doi = 10.1006/jmbi.2000.4315 | journal = Journal of Molecular Biology | volume = 305 | issue = 3 | pages = 567–580 | year = 2001 | pmid =  11152613| s2cid = 15769874 }}</ref> and [[bioinformatics]]<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Dyrløv Bendtsen | first1 = J. | last2 = Nielsen | first2 = H. | last3 = Von Heijne | first3 = G. | author-link3 = Gunnar von Heijne| last4 = Brunak | first4 = S. | author-link4 = Søren Brunak| title = Improved Prediction of Signal Peptides: SignalP 3.0 | doi = 10.1016/j.jmb.2004.05.028 | journal = Journal of Molecular Biology | volume = 340 | issue = 4 | pages = 783–795 | year = 2004 | pmid =  15223320}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Von Heijne | first1 = G. | author-link = Gunnar von Heijne| title = A new method for predicting signal sequence cleavage sites | doi = 10.1093/nar/14.11.4683 | journal = Nucleic Acids Research | volume = 14 | issue = 11 | pages = 4683–4690 | year = 1986 | pmid =  3714490| pmc =311474 }}</ref> at the Stockholm Center for Biomembrane Research at [[Stockholm University]].

==Education==
Von Heijne graduated 1975 with a Master of Science degree in chemistry and [[chemical engineering]] from the [[Royal Institute of Technology]] (KTH).<ref name="CV">[http://www.smb.org.mx/XXVICONGRESO/text/CVInvitados/CVHeijne.pdf Gunnar von Heijne's CV] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081203181420/http://www.smb.org.mx/XXVICONGRESO/text/CVInvitados/CVHeijne.pdf |date=3 December 2008 }}</ref> He then became a doctoral student in [[theoretical physics]] at KTH, in a research group focussing on [[statistical mechanics]] and theoretical [[biophysics]], and was awarded his PhD in 1980.<ref>Heijne, Gunnar von (1980): ''Some theoretical aspects of the structure, function and evolution of biological macromolecules'', Diss., Stockholm</ref> In 1983 he was made [[docent]] in theoretical biophysics at KTH, where he remained until 1988. 1982–1985 he was active as a science reporter at [[Sveriges Radio]]. 1989–1994 he was active at [[Karolinska Institutet]], and in 1994 he was made a professor in [[theoretical chemistry]] at [[Stockholm University]].<ref name="CV"/>

==Research==
Von Heijne's research primarily concerns [[membrane protein]]s, and he is one of the most cited Swedish scientists in the areas of [[biochemistry]] and [[molecular biology]].<ref name="ÅA"/> He heads the ''Center for Biomembrane Research'' at Stockholm University.<ref>[http://www.cbr.su.se/ Stockholm Center for Biomembrane Research] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090917194709/http://www.cbr.su.se/ |date=17 September 2009 }}. Retrieved 3 August 2009</ref>

==Awards==
In 2012 he was awarded the [[Accomplishment by a Senior Scientist Award]]<ref name="iscb">{{Cite journal | last1 = Mullins | first1 = J. | last2 = Morrison Mckay | first2 = B. J. | doi = 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002535 | title = International Society for Computational Biology Honours Gunnar von Heijne and Ziv Bar-Joseph with Top Bioinformatics/Computational Biology Awards for 2012 | journal = PLOS Computational Biology | volume = 8 | issue = 5 | article-number = e1002535 | year = 2012 | pmc =3364933 | bibcode = 2012PLSCB...8E2535M | doi-access = free }}</ref> by the [[International Society for Computational Biology]].

von Heijne is a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] since 1997 and a member of the [[Nobel Committee for Chemistry]] from 2001 to 2009, and the Committees chairman from 2007 to 2009. In 2008, he received an honorary doctorate at [[Åbo Akademi]].<ref name="ÅA">[http://www.abo.fi/public/media/6725/hedersdoc_sve_pdf.pdf Press release from Åbo Akademi: ''Åbo Akademi kreerar fjorton nya hedersdoktorer'']{{Dead link|date=January 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} {{in lang|sv}}</ref>
